locations.name: Stormwind City
locations.fieldNote: Started the day at Darkmoon Faire outside Stormwind and entered the Stockade.

locations.name: Westfall
locations.fieldNote: Began the mysterious chain of notes with Thundrus Cheeklapper.

locations.name: Ironforge
locations.fieldNote: Ended the day's travels in the city.

locations.name: Wetlands
locations.fieldNote: Visited the excavation site for the dungeon expedition.

locations.name: Shadowfang Keep
locations.fieldNote: Defeated all dungeon bosses with Furrassic Maul and Melan Holya.

locations.name: Darkmoon Faire
locations.fieldNote: Visited the fair outside Stormwind and earned Darkmoon Faire tickets.

locations.name: The Stockade
locations.fieldNote: Cleared every boss alongside Furrassic Maul and Melan Holya.

locations.name: Silverpine Forest
locations.fieldNote: Travelled through the region to Shadowfang Keep.

locations.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
locations.fieldNote: Defeated Saltspine, Shadetooth, Highland Horror, and Relic Guardian.

locations.name: The Barrens
locations.fieldNote: Reached Ratchet, cleared Wailing Caverns and followed the burned-tower clue.

locations.name: Ratchet
locations.fieldNote: Arrived by the coast on the way to Wailing Caverns.

locations.name: Wailing Caverns
locations.fieldNote: Cleared every boss with Furrassic Maul and Melan Holya and acquired the Cloak of Hermitic Bliss.

locations.name: Fray Island
locations.fieldNote: Completed The Affray with Thundrus Cheeklapper, unlocking Berserker Stance and Intercept.

locations.name: Stonetalon Mountains
locations.fieldNote: Followed another mysterious note with Thundrus Cheeklapper; the quest trail remains unfinished.

locations.name: Dun Morogh
locations.fieldNote: Travelled through a snowstorm on the way to Gnomeregan.

locations.name: Gnomeregan
locations.fieldNote: Cleared all six boss encounters with Furrassic Maul and Melan Holya.
